name: Koala Containers
tagline: Shipping containers for sale and hire, delivered anywhere in Australia. Your unit comes out of the yard closest to you rather than being carted across the country, and you can walk into ours at Cornubia any weekday.
yardPromise: A yard you can walk into
yardDetail: The containers sit on hardstand at Cornubia, half an hour south-east of Brisbane off the M1. Ring first, drive over, open the doors and look down the floor yourself before you spend a dollar.
responsePromise: Every enquiry answered within one business day
responseDetail: You hear back from a person, not an autoresponder. Enquiries that land on a weekend are answered the next business day.
nationalPromise: A container closer than you think
nationalDetail: We hold and draw stock through yards and depot partners around the country, so for most addresses the container starts its run somewhere reasonably close rather than crossing the continent. Give us the address and we will tell you where yours comes from.

depots.note: Head yard. Walk in, ring first.

video.title: Inside a Koala Containers yard
video.caption: Two minutes on what actually turns up when you order a container from us.
